title: 蚂蚁要搬家了
subtitle: 下雨之前的小秘密
style: children's picture book illustration, storybook art, soft watercolor painting, gentle rounded lineart, warm pastel colors, flat shading
neg_extra: (Flux 是蒸馏模型，负面提示词无效，此字段仅作记录)

pages.zh:
小路上，
明明蹲下来看。
pages.scene: A little Asian boy about four years old with short black hair, wearing a green t-shirt and dark blue shorts, crouches down on a sunny garden path. In front of him five black ants walk in a neat line across the brown dirt.

pages.zh:
一只，两只，三只……
每只都扛着东西。
pages.scene: Five black ants walking in a row across brown dirt, seen up close at ground level, each ant carrying a pale crumb or a small seed on its back. Blades of green grass at the edge of the picture.

pages.zh:
「你们要去哪儿呀？」
明明小声地问。
pages.scene: A little Asian boy about four years old with short black hair, wearing a green t-shirt and dark blue shorts, leans down with his hands on his knees and brings his face close to the dirt path, talking to a line of small black ants.

pages.zh:
蚂蚁不回答，
只是走得更快了。
pages.scene: A little Asian boy about four years old with short black hair, wearing a green t-shirt and dark blue shorts, kneels on a dirt garden path and watches a line of five tiny black ants hurrying past his knees. The ants are very small next to the boy's hand.

pages.zh:
天上的云，
慢慢变黑了。
pages.scene: A wide view of a garden path with green plants on both sides. The sky above is filling with heavy dark grey storm clouds. A little Asian boy in a green t-shirt and dark blue shorts stands small in the middle of the path, looking up at the darkening sky.

pages.zh:
蚂蚁搬出白白的蛋，
抱得紧紧的。
pages.scene: A close view of several black ants hurrying in a line across brown dirt, each ant carrying a small white oval egg held carefully in its jaws.

pages.zh:
啪嗒。
第一滴雨掉下来了。
pages.scene: One big raindrop splashing down onto the dry brown dirt of a garden path and making a dark wet circle, right beside a line of small black ants. The open hand of a little boy reaches into the picture from above.

pages.zh:
蚂蚁钻进土里的小洞。
一只，两只，全都不见了。
pages.scene: Black ants disappearing one after another into a small round hole in the brown dirt at the base of a green plant. The last ant is halfway inside the hole.

pages.zh:
大雨哗啦啦。
明明撑着红伞，
站在小洞旁边。
pages.scene: A little Asian boy about four years old with short black hair, wearing a green t-shirt and dark blue shorts, stands in heavy falling rain holding a bright red umbrella over his head. He looks down at a small ant hole in the wet muddy path. Long rain streaks fall all around him.

pages.zh:
雨停了。
蚂蚁又出来了，
天上挂着一道彩虹。
pages.scene: The rain has stopped. Black ants come back out of a small hole onto a shiny wet garden path. A little Asian boy in a green t-shirt and dark blue shorts stands smiling, and a bright rainbow arches across the clearing sky behind him.

colophon.lora_note: 18 张照片训练，触发词 ohwx boy
colophon.time:
训练 1h20m (kohya sd-scripts, blocks_to_swap 28)
出图约 103 秒 / 页
colophon.note: 画里的小男孩是用 18 张他自己的照片训出来的人物 LoRA 画的。画风是水彩而不是最初计划的蜡笔——FLUX.1-dev 天生画得更精细，蜡笔的颗粒感它压不出来（换成 schnell 才有，但 LoRA 只认 dev）。顺着模型的长处走，比硬顶更好看。
